14200.meaning1: learned the craft; acquired the skill

14201.meaning2: to learn; to study; to pick up

examples.text: visenikatvā pana ye caranti, diṭṭhīhi diṭṭhiṃ avirujjhamānā, tesu tvaṃ kiṃ labhetho pasūra, yes'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītaṃ.
kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā, mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ.

14203.meaning1: should be learned; should be grasped

examples.text: tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti na sotaṃ odahissanti na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.

14206.commentary: (MNt) uggahetum'pi'ti yathābhūtaṃ dhammaṃ dhāraṇaparipucchāparicayavasena hadayena uggahitaṃ suvaṇṇabhājane pakkhittasīhavasā viya avinaṭṭhe kātum'pi.

examples.text: ādiṃ kathāya majjhañ'ca, pariyosānañ'ca tādiso, uggahetuṃ na sakkoti, paññā hi'ssa na vijjati.
bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, pakkhagaṇanaṃ uggahetun'ti. atha kho bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi, kena nu kho pakkhagaṇanā uggahetabbā'ti?
ratanaṃ vā pana bhikkhunā ratanasammataṃ vā ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipitabbaṃ, yassa bhavissati, so harissatī'ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.

atha kho sabhiyo paribbājako tassā devatāya santike te pañhe uggahetvā ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa… te upasaṅkamitvā te pañhe pucchati.
na tāv'āhaṃ, pāpima, parinibbāyissāmi, yāva me bhikkhuniyo na sāvikā bhavissanti… sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ uggahetvā ācikkhissanti desessanti paññapessanti paṭṭhapessanti

14209.meaning1: having learned; having grasped; having picked up

examples.text: ādiṃ kathāya majjhañ'ca, pariyosānañ'ca tādiso, nisinno āsane tasmiṃ, uggahetvāna byañjanaṃ, vuṭṭhito nappajānāti, gahitaṃ hi'ssa mussati.

14213.meaning2: belch, ejection of wind from the stomach

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto samayappavādake tinduk'ācīre ekasālake mallikāya ārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ pañcamattehi paribbājakasatehi.

14220.meaning1: (of a weapon) lifts up; raises; brandishes
14220.commentary: (VIN 2.5.8.5) talasattikaṃ uggireyyā'ti kāyaṃ vā kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ vā antamaso uppalapattam'pi uccāreti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa kupito anattamano talasattikaṃ uggireyya, pācittiyaṃ.

14228.meaning1: to cough up; to hack up; to retch up; to vomit up
14228.commentary: (MNa) uggilitun'ti dve ante mocetvā kathetuṃ asakkonto uggilituṃ bahi nīharituṃ na sakkhiti.

examples.text: imaṃ kho te, rājakumāra, samaṇo gotamo ubhatokoṭikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno n'eva sakkhiti uggilituṃ na sakkhiti ogilituṃ.

14229.commentary: (ANa) katamo ca puggalo ugghaṭitaññū, yassa puggalassa saha udāhaṭavelāya dhamm'ābhisamayo hoti, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo ugghaṭitaññū.

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? ugghaṭitaññū, vipañcitaññū, neyyo, padaparamo, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

14231.meaning1: who grasps the meaning of a brief statement
14231.commentary: (ANa) katamo ca puggalo ugghaṭitaññū, yassa puggalassa saha udāhaṭavelāya dhamm'ābhisamayo hoti, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo ugghaṭitaññū.

examples.text: cattāro'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame cattāro? ugghaṭitaññū, vipañcitaññū, neyyo, padaparamo, ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

14232.meaningLit: discourse on one who grasps the meaning of a brief statement

14234.commentary: (SNPa) ugghaṭṭapādo'ti maggagamanena ghaṭṭapādatalo, paṇhikāya vā paṇhikaṃ, gopphakena vā gopphakaṃ, jaṇṇukena vā jaṇṇukaṃ āhacca ghaṭṭapādo. (JAa) ugghaṭṭapādan'ti uṇhavālukāya ghaṭṭitapādaṃ. (JAa) ugghaṭṭapādo'ti raj'okiṇṇapādo.

examples.text: ugghaṭṭapādo tasito, paṅkadanto rajassiro, so ca naṃ upasaṅkamma, satāni pañca yācati.
ghamme pathe brāhmaṇa ekabhikkhuṃ, ugghaṭṭapādaṃ tasitaṃ kilantaṃ, paṭipādayī saṅkha upāhanāni, sā dakkhiṇā kāmaduhā tav'ajja.

14235.commentary: (SNPa) ugghaṭṭapādo'ti maggagamanena ghaṭṭapādatalo, paṇhikāya vā paṇhikaṃ, gopphakena vā gopphakaṃ, jaṇṇukena vā jaṇṇukaṃ āhacca ghaṭṭapādo. (JAa) ugghaṭṭapādan'ti uṇhavālukāya ghaṭṭitapādaṃ. (JAa) ugghaṭṭapādo'ti raj'okiṇṇapādo.

examples.text: ugghaṭṭapādo tasito, paṅkadanto rajassiro, so ca naṃ upasaṅkamma, satāni pañca yācati.
ghamme pathe brāhmaṇa ekabhikkhuṃ, ugghaṭṭapādaṃ tasitaṃ kilantaṃ, paṭipādayī saṅkha upāhanāni, sā dakkhiṇā kāmaduhā tav'ajja.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso medakathālikaṃ parihareyya chidd'āvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, imaṃ kāyaṃ pariharāmi chidd'āvachiddaṃ uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ.

14246.meaning2: screen that can be opened; shutter

examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, mayaṃ idha pāsāde nisinnā imesu jālavātapānesu ugghāṭitesu mahantena ākāsena bahimukhā suṭṭhutaraṃ rūpaṃ passāma, evam'etena abbhantare jīvenā'pi cakkhudvāresu ugghāṭitesu mahantena ākāsena suṭṭhutaraṃ rūpaṃ passitabbaṃ… ?

14249.commentary: (APAa) bhavā ugghāṭitā mayā'ti sabbe nava bhavā mayā viddhaṃsitā. (NIDD1a) ugghāṭitānī'ti uppāṭitāni. samugghāṭitānī'ti visesena uppāṭitāni.

examples.text: oropito ca me bhāro, bhavā ugghāṭitā mayā, karaṇīyaṃ kataṃ sabbaṃ, sakyaputtassa sāsane.

vivaṭan'ti taṇhāchadanaṃ diṭṭhichadanaṃ kilesachadanaṃ duccaritachadanaṃ avijjāchadanaṃ. tāni chadanāni vivaṭāni honti viddhaṃsitāni ugghāṭitāni samugghāṭitāni pahīnāni samucchinnāni vūpasantāni paṭipassaddhāni abhabb'uppattikāni ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍhāni.

14250.meaning2: understanding what is revealed; understanding what is (merely) unveiled, taught briefly; of very swift understanding

14253.meaning1: wanting to reveal; wishing to open up

examples.text: aññavādako nāma saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjīyamāno taṃ na kathetu'kāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetu'kāmo aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati
vihesako nāma saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjīyamāno taṃ na kathetu'kāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetu'kāmo tuṇhībhūto saṅghaṃ viheseti. eso vihesako nāma.

14254.meaning1: to open; to reveal; to explain in detail

examples.text: aññavādako nāma saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjīyamāno taṃ na kathetu'kāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetu'kāmo aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati
vihesako nāma saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjīyamāno taṃ na kathetu'kāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetu'kāmo tuṇhībhūto saṅghaṃ viheseti. eso vihesako nāma.
ete vivādā samaṇesu jātā, etesu ugghāti nighāti hoti, etam'pi disvā virame kath'ojjaṃ, na h'añña'd'atth'atthi pasaṃsalābhā.

14261.meaning2: removed (of kasiṇa concept when entering upon 1st āruppa)

examples.text: itthī, bhikkhave, gacchantīpi purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati, ṭhitā'pi … nisinnā'pi… sayānā'pi… hasantī'pi… bhaṇantī'pi… gāyantī'pi… rodantī'pi… ugghātitā'pi … matā'pi purisassa cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati.

jayena cittaṃ ugghātitaṃ hoti parājayena cittaṃ nigghātitaṃ hoti, lābhena cittaṃ ugghātitaṃ hoti alābhena cittaṃ nigghātitaṃ hoti, yasena cittaṃ ugghātitaṃ hoti ayasena cittaṃ nigghātitaṃ hoti, pasaṃsāya cittaṃ ugghātitaṃ hoti nindāya cittaṃ nigghātitaṃ hoti, sukhena cittaṃ ugghātitaṃ hoti dukkhena cittaṃ nigghātitaṃ hoti, somanassena cittaṃ ugghātitaṃ hoti domanassena cittaṃ nigghātitaṃ hoti, unnatiyā cittaṃ ugghātitaṃ hoti onatiyā cittaṃ nigghātitaṃ hotī'ti, etesu ugghātinighāti hoti.
so kira guḷa-phāṇita-khaṇḍa-sakkhar'ādīni sakaṭen'ādāya paccantagāmaṃ gantvā visakaṇṭakaṃ gaṇhatha, visakaṇṭakaṃ gaṇhathā'ti ugghosesi.

tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ambho purisa, yassa tvaṃ pāsādassa ārohaṇāya nisseṇiṃ karosi, jānāsi taṃ pāsādaṃ puratthimāya vā disāya dakkhiṇāya vā disāya pacchimāya vā disāya uttarāya vā disāya ucco vā nīco vā majjhimo vā'ti?
na nīce āsane nisīditvā ucce āsane nisinnassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
āyuṃ arogiyaṃ vaṇṇaṃ, saggaṃ uccākulīnataṃ, ratiyo patthayantena, uḷārā apar'āparā.

14275.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha
14275.commentary: (MNa) satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso ucc'aṅgamāyo'ti ime pañca janā.

examples.text: satthā pavattā sarabhaṅgo lomahaṃso, ucc'aṅgamāyo asito anāsavo, manomayo mānacchido ca bandhumā, tadādhimutto vimalo ca ketumā.

14276.meaning1: who is in a high position; occupying a high station

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā uccaṭṭhāniyaṃ nīce ṭhāne ṭhapeti. yesaṃ taṃ amanāpaṃ tesaṃ evaṃ hoti, rājā kho pabbajitena saṃsaṭṭho.
anujānāmi, bhikkhave, navakena bhikkhunā uddisantena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ, uccatare vā dhammagāravena, therena bhikkhunā uddisāpentena samake vā āsane nisīdituṃ, nīcatare vā dhammagāravenā'ti.
tassa vaḍḍhanti vedanā, anekā rūpasambhavā, abhijjhā ca vihesā ca, cittam'ass'ūpahaññati, evaṃ ācinato dukkhaṃ, ārā nibbānam'uccati.
sabbehi dhātūhi bhāvakammesu yapaccayo hoti. ṭhīyate, bujjhate, paccate, labbhate, karīyate, yujjate, uccate. bhāvakammesū'ti kim'atthaṃ? karoti, pacati, paṭhati.

14280.notes: uccante is pr reflx 3rd pl 'they are pronounced'

examples.text: saṃyogato pubbe eo rassā iva-uccante kvaci, anantarā byañjanā saṃyogo.

14284.synonym: upacaya, khandha, caya, puñja, rāsi, sannicaya, samussaya

examples.text: pāpañ'ce puriso kayirā, na naṃ kayirā punappunaṃ, na tamhi chandaṃ kayirātha, dukkho pāpassa uccayo.

14290.meaning2: up and down; in various ways; in a changing manner

14291.meaning2: having a raised site, raised foundation or platform

14292.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ucca

examples.text: uccāsayana-mahāsayanā paṭivirato hoti jātarūpa-rajata-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti
so tam'anugacchati. tam'anugacchanto passati nāgavane mahantaṃ hatthipadaṃ, dīghato ca āyataṃ, tiriyañ'ca vitthataṃ, uccā ca nisevitaṃ.

14293.meaning2: type of female elephant (with defective tusks?)

14294.meaning2: type of female elephant (with projecting or wide-spreading tusks)

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo? idha, bhikkhave, asappuriso uccākulā pabbajito hoti. so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi uccākulā pabbajito, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na uccākulā pabbajitā'ti.

14296.meaning2: belonging to a noble family; from a good family

14297.meaning1: coming from a high class family; born into a distinguished family

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, asappuriso mahākulā pabbajito hoti… [yathā uccākulavāre tathā vitthāretabbaṃ]

14299.meaning1: from a high class family; belong to an eminent family; aristocratic
14299.meaning2: belonging to a family of high rank
14299.commentary: (ANa) uccākulikānan'ti ucce kule jātānaṃ. (ANt) ucca-saddena samān'attho uccā-saddo'ti āha, uccākulikānan'ti ucce kule jātānan'ti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uccākulikānaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāyaputto.
